text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've come out to watch some
scrimmages, and
while I'm waiting for the
next one to start...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. May I ask you for some
advice?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have checked the weather and
track
conditions and reviewed my
opponent's records
to see where they
usually make their move...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I have also planned different positions to
take
during the race so I can handle any
and all
unforeseen circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
One would think my preparations for this
race are
more than sufficient, yet
something still feels
amiss...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If it means I can increase my chances of
winning
by even one percent, then I
want to explore that
possibility as
thoroughly as possible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What do you think is the most important
thing to
do before a race? I would
appreciate your
thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I do that already, of course... Wait, are
you
saying I should train even more?
choice_data_list: ぎりぎりまでトレーニング
前のレースを観察する

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see. One must train until the very last
moment.
All this time, my resolve was
lacking. You've
opened my eyes to a
new perspective.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I suppose the best I can do now is some
weight
training. I will go to the gym
immediately!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In any case, warming up my body
shouldn't do me
any harm.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the advice. Now, if you'll
excuse
me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I never fail to do that in the first place.

Comparative research is vital to
discussions. Past
race analysis and—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wait... You mean I should watch the
races
immediately before my own? I do
need to
understand the turf condition
for my
calculations...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I won't be able to view them from
different
angles. I should ask permission
to go up the
watchtower... No, that's
going too far.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, forgive me for ignoring you. I
appreciate your
input on the matter. I'm
sure it will be of great
use.
